description: A throwing resolver against two COMPLETE catalogs, so the throw rather than a missing branch is what fails each candidate. Under any-failure both candidates are attempted, so the resolver is invoked once per candidate with a different locale each time and both invocations are recorded as throwing. A tagged value on the same fixture must render without reaching the resolver at all -- and because the resolver would have thrown, that absence is falsifiable by exception rather than only by the channel.
